sentence: Your name came up at the meeting today.
zh-TW: 今天開會時有人提到你的名字。
tagging_notes: come up 在此為「被提及」

sentence: I grew up in a small town.
zh-TW: 我在一個小鎮長大。

sentence: Come in and have a seat.
zh-TW: 請進，坐吧。

sentence: They had a fight but made up the next day.
zh-TW: 他們吵了一架，但隔天就和好了。

sentence: You can look up the word in a dictionary.
zh-TW: 你可以在字典裡查這個字。

sentence: I can't figure out how this app works.
zh-TW: 我搞不懂這個應用程式怎麼用。

sentence: Why don't we sit down over there?
zh-TW: 我們要不要去那邊坐下？

sentence: Can you take out the trash tonight?
zh-TW: 你今晚可以把垃圾拿出去倒嗎？
tagging_notes: take out 在此為「拿出去」

sentence: Gas prices have gone down this month.
zh-TW: 這個月油價下降了。

sentence: Only five people showed up to the party.
zh-TW: 只有五個人來參加派對。

sentence: Everyone, please stand up.
zh-TW: 各位，請起立。

sentence: The price will come down after the holidays.
zh-TW: 假期過後價格會降下來。

sentence: The rent went up again this year.
zh-TW: 今年房租又漲了。

sentence: When I look back, I don't regret anything.
zh-TW: 回想起來，我一點都不後悔。

sentence: I woke up late this morning.
zh-TW: 我今天早上睡過頭了。

sentence: The dentist pulled out my bad tooth.
zh-TW: 牙醫把我那顆壞牙拔掉了。

sentence: He turned around and waved goodbye.
zh-TW: 他轉過身揮手道別。

sentence: Don't look down when you're on the ladder.
zh-TW: 在梯子上的時候不要往下看。
tagging_notes: look down 在此為「往下看」

sentence: This song brings back so many memories.
zh-TW: 這首歌勾起好多回憶。
tagging_notes: bring back 在此為「喚起（回憶）」，屬「帶回」的引申義

sentence: Look out! There's a car coming.
zh-TW: 小心！有車來了。

sentence: We need to bring in more customers.
zh-TW: 我們需要吸引更多客人上門。
tagging_notes: bring in 在此為「帶來、引進」

sentence: It took him a while to open up to us.
zh-TW: 他花了一段時間才對我們敞開心扉。
tagging_notes: open up 在此為「敞開心扉」

sentence: What time do we need to check out?
zh-TW: 我們幾點要退房？

sentence: They quickly put out the fire.
zh-TW: 他們很快就把火撲滅了。

sentence: We're just looking around, thanks.
zh-TW: 我們只是隨便看看，謝謝。

sentence: You go in first, and I'll wait here.
zh-TW: 你先進去，我在這裡等。

sentence: Our car broke down on the highway.
zh-TW: 我們的車在高速公路上拋錨了。

sentence: Let's get off the bus here.
zh-TW: 我們在這裡下公車吧。

sentence: Put down your phone and eat your dinner.
zh-TW: 把手機放下，吃你的晚餐。

sentence: Feel free to reach out if you have questions.
zh-TW: 有問題的話歡迎隨時聯絡我。

sentence: We got cut off in the middle of the call.
zh-TW: 我們講到一半電話就斷了。
tagging_notes: cut off 在此為「（通話）被切斷」

sentence: A taxi pulled up in front of the hotel.
zh-TW: 一輛計程車在飯店門口停了下來。
tagging_notes: pull up 在此為「（車輛）停下」

sentence: Let's clean up the kitchen after dinner.
zh-TW: 晚餐後我們把廚房打掃乾淨吧。

sentence: My laptop keeps shutting down by itself.
zh-TW: 我的筆電一直自己關機。

sentence: Turn over the pancake when it's golden.
zh-TW: 鬆餅變金黃色時就翻面。

sentence: Slow down! You're driving too fast.
zh-TW: 慢一點！你開太快了。

sentence: We wound up eating at a small cafe.
zh-TW: 我們最後在一家小咖啡館吃飯。
tagging_notes: wind up 在此為「結果、最後落得」，屬「結束」義的口語用法

sentence: Please line up at the door.
zh-TW: 請在門口排隊。

sentence: I'd like to take back what I said.
zh-TW: 我想收回我剛才說的話。
tagging_notes: take back 在此為「收回（話）」

sentence: Let's go over the report one more time.
zh-TW: 我們把報告再檢查一次吧。

sentence: Don't hang up, I'm still here.
zh-TW: 別掛電話，我還在。

sentence: Hold on, let me get a pen.
zh-TW: 等一下，我拿支筆。

sentence: It took me five years to pay off my loan.
zh-TW: 我花了五年才還清貸款。

sentence: I don't know how long I can hold out.
zh-TW: 我不知道自己還能撐多久。

sentence: The company brought out a new phone.
zh-TW: 這家公司推出了一款新手機。

sentence: The dog pulled back when I reached for it.
zh-TW: 我伸手要摸那隻狗時，牠往後一縮。

sentence: Exercise helps you build up your strength.
zh-TW: 運動可以幫助你增強體力。

sentence: Can I throw out these old magazines?
zh-TW: 我可以把這些舊雜誌丟掉嗎？

sentence: Do you want to hang out this weekend?
zh-TW: 你這週末想出來玩嗎？

sentence: Put on a jacket. It's cold outside.
zh-TW: 穿件外套吧，外面很冷。

sentence: Get down from that chair right now!
zh-TW: 馬上從那張椅子上下來！

sentence: Why don't you come over for dinner?
zh-TW: 你要不要過來吃晚餐？
tagging_notes: come over 在此為「過來（拜訪）」

sentence: My new neighbors moved in last week.
zh-TW: 我的新鄰居上週搬進來了。

sentence: She started out as a waitress.
zh-TW: 她一開始是當服務生。
tagging_notes: start out 在此為「起步、一開始」

sentence: The teacher will call out your name.
zh-TW: 老師會叫你的名字。
tagging_notes: call out 在此為「點名、喊出」

sentence: Sit up straight, please.
zh-TW: 請坐直。

sentence: Please put back the books when you're done.
zh-TW: 看完請把書放回去。

sentence: We'll send out the invitations on Monday.
zh-TW: 我們週一會把邀請函寄出去。

sentence: What time does your flight get in?
zh-TW: 你的班機幾點到？

sentence: He blew up when he saw the bill.
zh-TW: 他看到帳單時大發脾氣。

sentence: We've run out of milk.
zh-TW: 我們的牛奶喝完了。

sentence: Don't forget to turn off the lights.
zh-TW: 別忘了關燈。

sentence: Please step back from the doors.
zh-TW: 請從門邊往後退。

sentence: Lay down your bags here for now.
zh-TW: 先把包包放在這裡吧。

sentence: The new tax will bring down prices.
zh-TW: 新的稅制會讓物價降低。

sentence: Wear something bright so you stand out.
zh-TW: 穿亮一點的衣服，你才會顯眼。

sentence: We're going to the beach. Want to come along?
zh-TW: 我們要去海邊，要一起來嗎？
tagging_notes: come along 在此為「一起來」

sentence: Let's wait and see how things play out.
zh-TW: 我們先等著看事情怎麼發展吧。
tagging_notes: play out 在此為「展開、發展」

sentence: A fire broke out in the building last night.
zh-TW: 昨晚那棟大樓發生火災。

sentence: There's a cold going around the office.
zh-TW: 辦公室裡正在流行感冒。
tagging_notes: go around 在此為「流傳」，指疾病傳染

sentence: Half the audience walked out before the end.
zh-TW: 一半的觀眾在結束前就離場了。

sentence: We'll get through this together.
zh-TW: 我們會一起度過這一關的。
tagging_notes: get through 在此為「撐過、度過」，接近「通過」義

sentence: I couldn't hold back my tears.
zh-TW: 我忍不住流下眼淚。

sentence: Let me write down your number.
zh-TW: 我把你的號碼寫下來。

sentence: Can you move back a little?
zh-TW: 你可以往後退一點嗎？

sentence: You need to fill out a form first.
zh-TW: 你得先填一張表。

sentence: Just sit back and enjoy the show.
zh-TW: 你就坐著好好欣賞表演吧。

sentence: The doctor wants to rule out an allergy.
zh-TW: 醫生想先排除過敏的可能。

sentence: Our meeting has been moved up to two o'clock.
zh-TW: 我們的會議提前到兩點了。
tagging_notes: move up 在此為「提前、往上移」

sentence: Help me pick out a gift for my mom.
zh-TW: 幫我挑一份禮物給我媽。

sentence: Let me take down your address.
zh-TW: 我記一下你的地址。

sentence: Which bus should I get on?
zh-TW: 我應該搭哪一班公車？

sentence: I'll give back your umbrella tomorrow.
zh-TW: 我明天把傘還你。

sentence: To sum up, the trip was a success.
zh-TW: 總而言之，這趟旅行很成功。

sentence: My roommate is moving out next month.
zh-TW: 我室友下個月要搬出去。

sentence: A button came off my shirt.
zh-TW: 我襯衫的一顆鈕扣掉了。

sentence: Could you pass on this message to Tom?
zh-TW: 你可以把這個訊息轉告 Tom 嗎？

sentence: There was too much information to take in.
zh-TW: 資訊太多了，一時消化不了。
tagging_notes: take in 在此為「理解、吸收」

sentence: Set down the box gently.
zh-TW: 輕輕把箱子放下。

sentence: She really came through for us this time.
zh-TW: 這次她真的幫了我們大忙。
tagging_notes: come through 在此為「（關鍵時刻）不負所望」，與「度過難關」義相近但不同，需人工確認

sentence: The kids finally settled down and went to sleep.
zh-TW: 孩子們終於安靜下來去睡了。
tagging_notes: settle down 在此為「安靜下來」

sentence: He was against it at first, but he came around.
zh-TW: 他一開始反對，後來改變主意了。
tagging_notes: come around 在此為「改變主意」

sentence: They give out free samples at the store.
zh-TW: 那家店會發免費試用品。

sentence: My son kept asking, so I finally gave in.
zh-TW: 我兒子一直問，我最後就讓步了。
tagging_notes: give in 在此為「讓步、屈服」

sentence: I'll go along with whatever you decide.
zh-TW: 你決定怎樣我都配合。
tagging_notes: go along 在此為「贊同、配合」

sentence: They broke off their engagement.
zh-TW: 他們解除了婚約。

sentence: Stop putting off your homework.
zh-TW: 別再拖延你的功課了。
tagging_notes: put off 在此為「拖延、推遲」

sentence: The bookstore on the corner closed down.
zh-TW: 轉角那家書店停業了。

sentence: She put in a lot of time on this project.
zh-TW: 她在這個專案上投入了很多時間。
tagging_notes: put in 在此為「投入（時間）」

sentence: We set about cleaning the house.
zh-TW: 我們開始動手打掃房子。
tagging_notes: set about 在此為「著手做」
